reply_text:
I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. The date for her tracker is Monday, November 3, 2025.

That comes from Moss's Coastal digest of Sunday, 2025-11-02. It says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". The digest doesn't name Kwame as the new owner. I said so in the reply.

I also warned her that "PHL" is shorthand for both Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Covey & Lark Retail, now Pellow Home Living. She should check that the tracker row is for Pellucid Harbor.
